note: Message categories and classification rules as data. A category is a row; a rule is a row ordered by priority (ascending, first match wins). matcherType ids resolve through a registry of RuleMatcher implementations, so a new kind of test is a new handler, not a branch.

rules.note: Relationship beats nature: a saved contact is Personal even when the message is promotional.
DLT -G suffix is the strongest government signal.

rules.pattern: trai|epfo|income tax|cbi|bribe|department of telecom|ministry of|narcotics control|cyber crime|cybercrime|cert-in|sancharsaathi|uidai|erss|police|gstin|gst department|gst notice|gst return|সিবিআই|ঘুষ|আয়কর|ইপিএফও|জিএসটি|সরকার
rules.note: Govt bodies in the text. Bare 'govt'/'government' deliberately excluded (scam ads say 'Modi Govt Growth Fund'); GST alone excluded (retail tax-saving hook).

rules.pattern: bill of rs|bill for|your bill|is due for payment|due date|due of|dues of|overdue|repay|payment of rs|receipt of rs|credited to your account|debited|outstanding|kindly pay|clear the due
rules.note: A real bill/payment outranks generic threat language. Above spam, so a genuine dunning notice ('services will be stopped ... clear the bill of Rs X') is transactional, not spam.

rules.pattern: you have won|you won|you've won|lottery|lucky draw|prize|gift card|claim your prize|congratulations
rules.note: Prize / lottery language. Bare 'winner' excluded: retail promos say 'match winner deal'.

rules.pattern: will be stopped|will be discontinued|will be deactivated|will be suspended|account blocked|account suspended|account will be
kyc is pending|kyc pending|kyc update|kyc expired|kyc has expired|kyc suspended|kyc blocked|complete your kyc|update your kyc|verify your kyc|kyc verification pending
rules.note: KYC-phishing phrasings. A bare mention of KYC (e.g. a legitimate courier) does not fire.

rules.pattern: otp|one time password|one-time password|verification code|login code|auth code|do not share|don't share|never share|share it with anyone|share this code|debited|withdrawn|spent|transferred|txn|transaction|payment of|paid to|successfully paid|payment confirmed|payment failed|amount paid|refund|credited with rs|digital receipt|recent purchase|data pack|activation code|a/c|acct|upi|neft|imps|missed call|minimum payment|renewal|auto-debit
rules.note: OTP + money movement + service notices. Bare 'credited'/'expiring'/'recharge'/'salary' removed: promos use them ('CREDITED INR 500 ... use code', 'cash expiring'). Real bill/due/overdue now sits in bill-transactional (priority 26).

rules.pattern: out for delivery|has been delivered|was delivered|delivery code|shipped|shipment|dispatched|arriving today|order #|order no|your order|tracking number|tracking id|awb|consignment
rules.note: Order lifecycle. Bare 'delivered'/'courier'/'parcel' removed: promos say 'delivered in 10 mins'.
DLT -P suffix. Placed after transactional/purchases so a service message is not read as a promo.

rules.pattern: % off|off on|flat|promo|offer|sale|redeem|coupon|use code|code:|discount|deal|cashback|activate|exclusive|limited period|limited time|shop now|buy now|order now|hurry|savings|save|free|upto|up to|enroll|master|course|program|collection|new in|just dropped|in-store|in store|available in stores|book your|claim now|shop|visit|upgrade|fest|rewards|voucher|bonus|points|earn|benefits|membership|loyalty|new arrival|launch|monsoon|summer|winter|festive|অফার|ছাড়|বিনামূল্যে|ট্রায়াল|লাইভ|প্ল্যান|সাবস্ক্রিপশন|উপভোগ|অ্যাকশন|ফ্রি
rules.note: Marketing language, incl. modern forms the seed missed (enrol/master/collection/claim now/visit/upgrade) and Bengali offers (Bengali text has no Latin markers).
An unsaved number sending human prose with no template marker is a person.
